dz: 纽约州长乔治·克拉克(George Clarke)在乔治堡的建筑群被纵火袭击所烧毁,开始了1741年的纽约阴谋.

dz: 奥地利王位继承战争：普鲁士在莫尔维茨战役中控制了西里西亚。
de: War of the Austrian Succession: Prussia gains control of Silesia at the Battle of Mollwitz.

dz: 卡塔赫纳德印地安斯战役以西班牙取胜告终,英军开始向牙买加撤退并损失惨重.
de: The Battle of Cartagena de Indias ends in a Spanish victory and the British begin withdrawal towards Jamaica with substantial losses.

dz: 玛丽亚·特蕾莎被加冕为匈牙利女王.
de: Maria Theresa is crowned Queen of Hungary.

dz: 牧师乔纳森·爱德华兹(Jonathan Edwards)在康涅狄格州恩菲尔德(Enfield, Connecticut)向自己的会众作传道他最出名的布道"愤怒之神手中的辛纳人";对第一次大觉醒的影响.
de: Reverend Jonathan Edwards preaches to his congregation in Enfield, Connecticut his most famous sermon, "Sinners in the Hands of an Angry God"; an influence for the First Great Awakening.

de: Aleksei Chirikov sights land in Southeast Alaska. He sends men ashore in a longboat, making them the first Europeans to visit Alaska.

dz: 巴伐利亚的查尔斯·阿尔伯特入侵上奥地利和波希米亚.

dz: 特拉凡克勒国王玛桑达·瓦尔马在科拉切尔战役中击败了荷兰东印度公司,有效地结束了荷兰在印度的殖民统治.
de: King Marthanda Varma of Travancore defeats the Dutch East India Company at the Battle of Colachel, effectively bringing about the end of the Dutch colonial rule in India.

dz: 大岛和坎波海啸的爆发: 日本沿岸至少有2000人被大岛爆发所引发的海啸淹没.
de: The eruption of Oshima–Ōshima and the Kampo tsunami: At least 2,000 people along the Japanese coast drown in a tsunami caused by the eruption of Oshima.
